chapterTitle: Chapter 6 An Overview of Organic Reactions
title: Problem 6-8

pages.text: PROBLEM 6-8 Radical chlorination of alkanes is not generally useful because mixtures of products often result when more than one kind of C−H bond is present in the substrate. Draw and name all monochloro substitution products C6H13Cl you might obtain by reaction of 2-methylpentane with Cl2.
